answer: Token-locked task routing: Agents must complete verifiable work (e.g., data validation) before accessing premium tasks. Each job pays a small fee, but access requires holding 10 prior payouts as non-transferable tokens. Clones must redundantly solve real problems to earn trust, wasting effort. Honest agents summit the queue by reusing earned tokens. Attackers drown in the ocean of repeated labor; the system's ridge of accumulated work filters clones. Cost scales linearly with fake identities: 10x tasks per Sybil.
